title: Are Neural Language Models Good Plagiarists? A Benchmark for Neural Paraphrase Detection
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not benchmark any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark measures the ability of classification models to detect machine-paraphrased text generated by neural language models.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
